test_image_classification_simple: test the image classification API by sending a JPEG image and verifying the response contains label and score fields
test_image_classification_different_reso: test the image classification API with a different resolution image to verify consistent label and score output
read_sample_image: read a sample image file from the samples directory and return its binary payload for API testing
setup_image_classification_test: set up the test environment by configuring MODEL_ID and TASK environment variables for image classification
teardown_image_classification_test: restore previous environment variables or delete MODEL_ID and TASK after running image classification tests
